title: Xinhua News | China, U.S. hold first meeting of trade council under economic, trade consultation mechanism

Xinhua News | China, U.S. hold first meeting of trade council under economic, trade consultation mechanism-Xinhua 
 Xinhua News | China, U.S. hold first meeting of trade council under economic, trade consultation mechanism
 Source: Xinhua
 Editor: huaxia
 2026-11-14 21:53:32
 China and the United States held the first meeting of the trade council under the China-U.S. economic and trade consultation mechanism via video link on Friday, China's Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday. #XinhuaNews
